gen-gf-oxanium-plus-jakarta-sans: Oxanium goes big and sharp, its tall lowercase drawn in one unbroken line. Plus Jakarta Sans is the quieter partner, a precise plain sans with moderate height and curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-oxanium-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any swell in the stroke. Over a long passage it stays easy to follow, since each c and s keeps its opening wide, while Oxanium up top is the commanding, tall-lowercase voice.
gen-gf-oxanium-space-grotesk: That tall lowercase is pure Oxanium, big and monoline with curves ending in daylight. Space Grotesk then carries a longer passage in a sans of constant-width ribbons, its counters breathing, a touch lower in height and noticeably more neutral.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-amulya: Loud, loose and confident. Paprika scatters its letters wide, then Amulya settles a longer passage into a contemporary sans whose generous curve gaps keep each line moving without fuss.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-chillax: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, scattered and expressive, with low-contrast strokes that feel commanding. Chillax relaxes beside it, a casual sans-serif of tube-like, constant-width lines.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-plein: Big, scattered, full of swagger. Paprika is the one to make lowercase shout like capitals, while Plein does the reliable work, a plain sans that leads a clear channel into every round letter.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-roundo: Expressive is the first word for Paprika, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. And Roundo, a geometric sans with stout diagonals and open small counters, makes a sensible choice at a modest size.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Paprika above it is the showy one, tall and scattered, and the rounded-wire stroke below makes a contemporary, friendly counterweight.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable, a plain stripe of ink with generous openings in every curve. Paprika overhead is the showman, its lowercase huge and its letters scattered, so the two feel like a shout and a steady answer.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out wide, deep in the lowercase, with a calm ebb and flow of stroke. Paprika does the loud, expressive work with its scattered, capital-sized lowercase, while Aclonica quietly handles the sustained reading.
